summary: Find same-color 8-connected nonzero objects and sort them by minimum row then minimum column. Average the minimum rows of the first and last sorted objects; objects strictly above that midpoint form the upper group and the rest form the lower group. Sort each group by minimum column, append upper then lower, and copy the first four bounding-box-normalized crops without rotation or recoloring to origins (0,0), (0,4), (4,0), and (4,4) on a zero-filled 7x7 grid, clipping cells outside that grid.
